en.title: Order Check (Backend)
en.description:
After sorting by height in ascending order, count the students in the original array who are not in their correct position.

This site's standard I/O format and any supplementary ranges follow this problem's statement.
en.input: n (1≤n≤100000), and the next line contains n heights (1≤height[i]≤10^9). The value ranges come from the original problem.
en.output: Output the number of students in incorrect positions.
en.explanation: Sort to get the target sequence, then compare position by position.
hints: Sort to get the target sequence, then compare position by position.
